mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER ( login_id, password, name, nickname, email, phone, birth_date, profile_img, region, postcode, address, address_detail, bio ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{birthDate}, #{profileImg}, #{region}, #{postcode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{bio} )
mapper.select:
SELECT user_id AS userId, login_id AS loginId, password, name, nickname AS nickname, email, phone, birth_date AS birthDate, profile_img AS profileImg, region, postcode, address, address_detail AS addressDetail, bio, provider, role, status, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, profile_visibility AS profileVisibility, show_liked_itinerary AS showLikedItinerary, show_bookmarked_itinerary AS showBookmarkedItinerary, notify_like AS notifyLike, notify_comment AS notifyComment
FROM TB_USER
WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
